newsitem.title: USA: TWA CEO Erickson to leave company.
newsitem.headline: TWA CEO Erickson to leave company.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc., troubled by the departure of key executives and the deadly crash of one of its jetliners in July, said Thursday that Chief Executive Officer Jeffrey Erickson has decided to leave the company in January.
Erickson, who joined the St. Louis-based airline in April 1994, was named chief executive officer in August of that year.

"I have decided that it is time for me to move on," Erickson said in a statement. "I look forward to working with the board during the next three months to select a qualified successor and effect a smooth transition."

TWA's Chief Financial Officer Robert Peiser, who was credited with developing a critical debt restructuring for the troubled carrier, quit in June. Before joining TWA, Erickson was chief executive of regional carrier Reno Air.
